title.en: Neon sign on a rainy night

summary.zh: 红砖墙上的手写体霓虹灯字，雨后街面拉出长长的倒影
summary.en: A hand-lettered neon sign on a brick wall, mirrored in a rain-wet street

prompt: A photorealistic night scene: a glowing neon sign mounted on a weathered red-brick wall, its glass tubes spelling “{{text}}” in flowing hand-lettered brush-script, in {{color}} neon with a soft halo and a faint glow on the bricks around it. Light rain; the wet pavement below mirrors the colours in long, rippling reflections; a dark wooden doorway and two potted plants at the edge of the frame. Cinematic 35mm look, shallow depth of field, rich contrast. The lettering is crisp and spelled exactly as given; no other text, no logos.
